headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Griffin Conine leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 behind Eduardo Rodriguez's strong performance on the mound, while the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2. The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Detroit Tigers in a high-scoring game, winning 10-9.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jose Corniell, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list. Danny Jansen, also of the Texas Rangers, has been moved to the 60-day injured list due to a right forearm strain. The Boston Red Sox have placed third baseman Curtis Mead on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 28, 2026, with a left wrist tracture. Other injured players include Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton, who is dealing with right hip impingement, and Tampa Bay Rays right-handed pitcher Cole Sulser, who has lower back spasms.

The Los Angeles Angels made a trade on July 29, 2026, acquiring shortstop Angel Arredondo from the Texas Rangers in exchange for catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth. The Baltimore Orioles traded right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash, while the San Diego Padres signed shortstop Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez leading the way on the mound. Rodriguez pitched 8.0 innings, allowing 0 earned runs and striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Walk Off in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Detroit Tigers in a high-scoring game, winning 10-9. Grant Wolfram earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Rangers RHP Jose Corniell Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-handed pitcher Jose Corniell has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Angels Acquire SS Angel Arredondo in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels made a move on July 29, 2026, acquiring shortstop Angel Arredondo from the Texas Rangers. In exchange, the Angels sent catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth to the Rangers.
